_about: dazl inbound mail receiver (ops/inbound-mail/README.md). Installed as /etc/dazl-inbound-mail/config.json. Keys starting with _ are comments. Secrets are NOT here: see /etc/dazl-inbound-mail/env.
_backend_url: The app's inbound endpoint on loopback. Production is blue/green on :3104/:3105: point this at the port Caddy serves (grep reverse_proxy /etc/caddy/Caddyfile) and update it after a deploy that switches ports.
_fallback_forward: The human inbox (the Worker's REPLY_FALLBACK_FORWARD). PLACEHOLDER: Hermes fills it in on the box. Empty = app mail that cannot be handled gets a 451, and other addresses are refused with 451, until it is set.
_routes: Address routing table. action: backend (the app contract) | forward (to 'to', or to fallback_forward when 'to' is absent) | reject ('reason'). PLACEHOLDER for the rest of the Cloudflare Email Routing rules: Hermes supplies the list; until then every other @dazl.ai address goes to fallback_forward (default_route), which is what the Cloudflare catch-all does today.
